Start free

Every meeting ends with a to-do list. Now someone actually writes it.

Upload a recording or connect your calendar. Recapline pulls out who agreed to do what, and by when, so nothing said in the room gets lost after it.

Try it free for 14 days See how it works

No credit card needed. Works with Zoom, Google Meet and Teams recordings.

What Recapline does

Three things, done well, so your follow-up email writes itself.

1

Finds the commitments

It listens for the moments people agree to take something on, and skips the small talk.

2

Assigns owners and dates

Each item gets a name and a deadline from what was said. Anything unclear is flagged for you to confirm.

3

Sends them where you work

Push items to Slack, Asana, Linear or email. Every item links back to the exact second it came from.

Teams that stopped losing follow-ups

Simple pricing
